description:
Get details for a specific payee.

Args:
  - budget_id (string, optional): Budget UUID. Omit to use the default budget.
  - payee_id (string, required): Payee UUID.
  - response_format (string, optional): "json" or "markdown" (default: "markdown").

Returns: payee (id, name, transfer_account_id, deleted), cached, cache_info

Errors:
  - "No default budget set" → run ynab_set_default_budget first
  - "Payee not found" → invalid payee_id
name: ynab_get_payee

cache_info.description: Human-readable cache status message (e.g., "Cache hit", "Cache miss")

cached.description: Indicates if data was served from cache

usedDelta.description: Indicates if delta merge optimization was applied for budgets
